submitted.rationale: I aimed at the Zn-poor side of the ZnSb2O6 trirutile photoanode phase (Sb fraction 0.667). The peak EQE was 0.847% at index 12 (Sb 0.611). Its neighbours measured lower: index 11 gave 0.790% and index 13 gave 0.449%. That brackets a local maximum near Sb 0.6.
